items.required: Either a target margin above the floor, or a commercial rounding rule that raises the price to a declared multiple as a separate, versioned adjustment
items.known: With target and minimum both 0.45, cost and price are rounded to whole CLP independently and each line can end under the floor by less than 1 CLP; the kernel reports MARGIN_BELOW_FLOOR as designed and never raises the price. marginAmountShortOfFloor in the compose summary separates this rounding gap from a real breach. Changing the kernel requires a new engine version and multi-version replay, so it is not done here

items.required: Every price actually agreed is run through the engine as the brief discount adjustment, with its reason, so the frozen artifact carries the real net, margin and floor verdict
items.known: The discount adjustment is rate-based: reaching an exact agreed amount needs the rate computed by hand with enough decimals. An adjustment that takes the agreed net directly would need an engine change. First case recorded this way: docs/commercial/prospects/sky-social-care-2027/pricing/acordado.*
